methods.evidenceBytes: Sum of UTF8 bytes of all frozen source text, including fixed sources. Verified against both snapshot and selected-source accounting.
methods.documents: Distinct document/version pairs among frozen selected sources, including fixed sources.
methods.excerpts: Selected source units with kind=excerpt; full documents are excluded from this count.
methods.median: Middle value, or arithmetic mean of the two middle values for even sample sizes.
methods.p90: Nearest rank, sorted value at ceil(0.90*n), with one-based ranks.
methods.efficiency: Pooled recovered facts divided by pooled frozen bytes/1000; never an average of case-level ratios.
methods.strict: Existing exact/normalized whole-case eligibility and recall, unchanged.
methods.lenient: Existing same-document/version, single-unit best-window lexical token recall at 0.8 and 0.9, unchanged.
methods.failedAttempts: Retained in all-run measurements. A failed capture with no frozen evidence contributes zero bytes, documents and excerpts.
methods.zeroByteDenominator: Efficiency is null when the denominator contains zero frozen bytes.
